name: 甜花
text:
怖い人たち……
もう、行っちゃった……？

name: 甜花
text: もうちょっとだけ……我慢……
trans: Just be... a little more patient......

name: 甜花
text:
きっと……
とっても、心配してる……

name: 甜花
text: 駅員さんに……言わなきゃ……
trans: Maybe we should tell... the station worker......

name: 甜花
text:
──怖い人たち……
早く……行ってくれればいい、のに……
trans: ──Tenka just wants... the bad guys to leave......

name: 甘奈
text:
警備員さんたち……
いないね……
trans: Doesn't seem like there's any security...

name: 甘奈
text: こっちの車両じゃなかったのかな……

name: 甘奈
text: 賞金稼ぎのこと、聞きたかったのに……
trans: I wanted to ask about the bounty hunters...

name: 甘奈
trans:
!
Did you find a bounty hunter!?

name: 千雪
text:
あ……ううん
ごめんね、違うの……
trans: Oh... no. Sorry to get your hopes up...

name: 甘奈
trans: ──|What a bad time... and yet, it's so pretty...

name: 甘奈
text:
３人で……
見るはずだったのにな……
trans: We were supposed to see it... all together...

name: 千雪
text:
そうね……
ハロウィンが終わる前に、『天船』に戻らなきゃ
trans:
I know, I get it... We have to return to the Celestial
Ship before Halloween is over.

name: 甘奈
text:
…………
船が行っちゃったら、どうなるのかな
trans:
......
I wonder what'd happen if it left without us.

name: 千雪
text:
最後になっちゃった
──はい
trans: This is our last one. Here you go.

name: 千雪
text:
うん
ちょっと食べすぎちゃったみたい
trans: Yeah. I think I ate too many anyways.

name: 千雪
text:
私たち、天の川に行くの
そして時間までに『天船』に乗る
trans:
We're all gonna go to the Milky Way. And once we get
there, we'll get back onto the Celestial Ship.

name: 甘奈
text:
──ごめんなさい
ありがとう……

name: 甘奈
text: 食べて、力貯めておかなきゃ
trans:
I'm gonna eat it so that I can regain some of my
strength.

name: 甘奈
text: 思い出、いっぱい作るんだもんね
trans: We're gonna make a ton of memories.

name: 甜花
text:
──あっ！
あんまり開けたら見つかっちゃう──
trans: ──Ah! If you open it too much they'll see──

name: 甜花
text:
──ええっ！
あれ……お兄ちゃん、なの……？

name: 甜花
trans: Which means... that's where your home is......?

name: 甜花
text: 仔馬さんは……仔馬座なの……！？

name: 甜花
text:
じゃあ、お兄ちゃんのとこ……
帰らなきゃ……
trans: So you gotta... go back to your big brother......

name: 甜花
trans: You know...... Tenka... has a little sister......

name: 甜花
text:
それから……
千雪さん……

name: 甜花
trans:
............
Tenka... has to get back too......
